shellCommands.command: git ls-files | grep -v node_modules | head -50 && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -iname '*blogheader*' -print; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cat app/BlogHeader.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; grep -ril "next/font" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | head

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; sed -n 1,140p 03-api-reference/02-components/font.md; grep -n -i -A3 "roboto\|variable font\|weight.*required\|module scope\|const " 03-api-reference/02-components/font.md | sed -n 1,120p; ls 01-getting-started/ | grep -i font

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; grep -n -i -B2 -A30 "multiple fonts" 03-api-reference/02-components/font.md | sed -n 1,80p; grep -n -i "scope\|same font" 01-getting-started/13-fonts.md 03-api-reference/02-components/font.md
cd /workspace && timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25
git diff --stat tsconfig.json && git checkout tsconfig.json
